# Inactive Inferno stale-moon exit

The unchanged original Inferno attachment affects both teams. A cardless
first-wave MageT1_Junker enters under Full while tracking is off; native then
sets global New without refreshing character understanding. Its recorded Bump
out of the room removes the original Inferno upgrade and changes mask 6 to 5.
Returning to Inferno restores that upgrade while the mask remains 5.

Two separate muted Instant native runs produced identical complete archive
roots, with original files unchanged. The model matches both complete
train/context and gameplay-RNG successors with eight immutable branches each.
Missing masks, preview, altered attachment identity, unknown spawner and moon
callbacks remain rejected. The 9,822-byte binary has 1,100 unique nodes and
SHA-256 `a9deaca62db71067ced02128c3907c21388ed4196b00d1415438962094b6e15b`.
This is original Bump component evidence; EndTurn ascension is separate.

```powershell
pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/Run-FullBattleProbe.ps1 -RoomMoonInactiveInfernoExit -GameSpeed Instant
pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/Check-Models.ps1 -Fixture room-moon-inactive-inferno-exit-calibration.mt2f
```
